rationale: This revised plan addresses all three feedback items from the prior evaluation. The critical leakage issue is resolved by removing member_sex, member_age_band, and fraud_pattern_type from the feature_comparison features, retaining only permitted claim-level features for comparison. The communication gaps are closed by adding synthetic_data and no_operational_use caveats to the report, clearly stating that this analysis uses synthetic data and must not inform operational fraud decisions.
changes_summary: Removed member_sex, member_age_band, and fraud_pattern_type from feature_comparison features to eliminate leakage of protected attributes and label-derived fields. Added synthetic_data and no_operational_use to write_report caveats to address missing communications about data provenance and operational constraints. All other components and parameters remain unchanged.
